question: What reassurance and instruction are given to Viṣṇu in the face of danger?
premises: Viṣṇu is told not to be afraid.
He is instructed to remain steady.
inference: Viṣṇu is reassured and urged to stand firm without fear.
plain_english: Do not be afraid, O Viṣṇu; be steady, O great-minded one.
